confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from London-specific 2026 web sources (crowd-sourced Numbeo figures, UK pub-trade surveys, guide sites) that often disagree, so each is a bounded central estimate. Beer assumes a pint and wine a 175 ml glass. Cocktail and wine are the weakest drink anchors and were cross-checked against the local beer price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for London's July peak-season level, not inspected booking pages or current listings; the hotel and mid-range meal anchors are the least certain. Pound prices were converted to USD at an approximate rate, and the RBA rate came from search-result text citing the RBA daily exchange-rate page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are London-specific from web sources, and accommodation anchors are holistic estimates of London's central-area July price level.
